rows.grounds: second member of compound describing cakraṃ

items.question: What form and status characterize the sixth cakra within this sequence?
premises: The sixth cakra is named in sequence.
It is designated as the king.
It is described as having eight petals.
It is described as possessing a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is identified as a sovereign eight-petaled center with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of the accusatives without an explicit governing verb is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the king, having eight petals and a pericarp.
